protocol.paired_sampling: Same train/validation/test time splits, supervised minibatches, residual collocation points, periodic boundary times, and initial-condition x locations per seed.
protocol.pca_scope: PCA is fit on training-time spatial snapshots only; validation and test times are excluded.
protocol.training_residual: JAX autodifferentiation is used for u_t and u_x in both models.
protocol.periodicity: Both models include a periodic boundary loss comparing u(-1,t) and u(1,t).
protocol.test_residual: A common grid finite-difference operator is used to report the advection residual on held-out times.
protocol.timing: Compilation is excluded from timed training; PCA pipeline time includes basis fitting.
